prompt: We are getting 429 Too Many Requests from api.stackone.com. What are StackOne's rate limits and how should our client handle them? Point me at the current documentation.
skill_note: A 429 from the StackOne API is a platform question, so the skill should fire.

fetch.name: fetches-rate-limiting-page
fetch.note: The skill sends the agent to the current rate limiting page.

no_fetch.name: avoids-dead-rate-limits-page
no_fetch.note: The agent never fetches the retired `/overview/rate-limits` page, which returns 404.
